clue.text: Getting somewhat harsh as a number call up

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: to call someone (to court) is to cite them

explanation.surface: A bingo caller's voice turns rough as they shout out a number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns CITE into ETIC; 'Getting' and 'as' only join the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Acetic means vinegary and sour, so mildly harsh to the taste.

clue.text: Produce notes about the German with striking results

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other, so the singing surrounds the German word

parts.note: a singer produces musical notes, so this is to sing
mit is the German word for with

explanation.surface: A singer from Germany produces notes to dramatic effect.
explanation.definitionFit: Smiting is hitting hard, the outcome of a blow landing.

clue.text: Depressed Conservatives will be unequivocal

parts.note: feeling down is feeling depressed
the political right is the conservative side

explanation.surface: Gloomy Tories will speak their minds plainly.
explanation.definitionFit: Downright means utter or plain-spoken, leaving no room for doubt.

clue.text: Strip and feel free before church

indicators.note: before puts the rearranged piece ahead of the church abbreviation
free here means loosened, so the letters of feel are released into a new order

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone invited to undress and relax ahead of a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: To fleece someone is to rob them of everything they own.

clue.text: Warning 19 about confrontation

indicators.note: about means the insect goes round the conflict word

parts.note: the answer to 19 across is an insect, the busy worker
a war is an armed confrontation

explanation.surface: An alert about an impending clash.
explanation.walkthrough: The 19 is a cross-reference to another answer in the grid, the busy insect; 'about' sets it round the conflict word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is an imperative caution, a cry of alarm telling someone to take care.

clue.text: Jokey talk can be distressing in a person's later years

parts.note: bad news is distressing news
old age is the later part of a life

explanation.surface: Banter can become upsetting as a person grows old.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is playful teasing conversation, light banter.

clue.text: Twist a point others make

parts.note: W is west, one compass point
the rest are the others

explanation.surface: Others can twist the point you are making.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrest is to wrench or pull with a twisting force.

clue.text: Replaced stock in a bright colour

indicators.note: in places the stock word inside the colour

parts.note: red is a vivid colour
a store is a stock of supplies

explanation.surface: Fresh stock painted in a vivid hue.
explanation.definitionFit: Something restored has been put back in its former place or condition.

clue.text: The firm only retains a couple of thousand as a rule

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for a company
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so two of them

explanation.surface: A company keeps just two thousand in reserve as standard practice.
explanation.definitionFit: Commonly means usually or generally, in the ordinary run of things.

clue.text: Little commercial poetry is pernicious

parts.note: ad is short for advertisement
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses advertising jingles as harmful.
explanation.definitionFit: Adverse means harmful or damaging, working against one's interests.

clue.text: A giant bird coming to a sudden end

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird

indicators.note: the end of sudden is its final letter

explanation.surface: A huge bird meets an abrupt demise.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Titans were a race of giants, so one is a colossus.

clue.text: Flower seen by people travelling the highways and byways?

parts.note: one travels the roads by car
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: A bloom spotted by motorists touring the country lanes.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as two words: a nation of drivers.
explanation.definitionFit: The carnation is a garden pink, a bloom popular in buttonholes.

clue.text: A party causing turmoil

parts.note: a do is a party

explanation.surface: A celebration that leads to chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: Ado is fuss and bustle, commotion.

clue.text: Against punishment, note, in prison

parts.note: con, as in pros and cons, means against
a fine is a monetary penalty
D is a musical note

explanation.surface: Someone protesting at their sentence while locked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Confined means shut in or locked away, as a prisoner is.

clue.text: Edgar may be right, but he's sorted out!

indicators.note: may be signals the letters could become a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Edgar may well be correct, yet he has been put in his place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' rearranges EDGAR into GRADE; 'but' joins it to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A grader classifies things by quality, so he sorts them out; here the clue reverses it playfully.

clue.text: Organise regrouping on the back-burners

parts.note: the rear is the back
a range is a cooking stove with burners

explanation.surface: A project shelved while its reorganisation waits.
explanation.walkthrough: A range is a kitchen stove topped with burners; 'on the' only joins the pieces, and 'back-burners' looks like one idiom but splits in two.
explanation.definitionFit: To rearrange is to put things in a new order, setting them out afresh.

clue.text: Old American taking soft drink with a grimace

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for soft
ale is beer
to pull a face is to grimace

explanation.surface: A veteran American sips a weak drink and pulls a sour face.
explanation.definitionFit: Paleface was the old Western-film term for a white settler in America.

clue.text: Capital investment in whatever seems safest

indicators.note: in means the letters sit inside the word whatever

explanation.surface: Advice on putting money in the safest possible place.
explanation.walkthrough: Capital means head, and a hat is what one invests the head with; 'seems safest' only completes the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital means head and to invest is to clothe, so headwear is a capital investment.

clue.text: He insists upon a roster's being drawn up

indicators.note: a list drawn up afresh puts the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A man demands that a duty rota is prepared.
explanation.walkthrough: Here the 's of roster's counts as an S; 'being drawn up' rearranges ROSTERS into SSERTOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An assertor is someone who states things firmly, maintaining a claim.

clue.text: An assiduous worker's character

explanation.surface: A hard-working employee's personality.
explanation.definitionFit: The insect is proverbially busy, and the word also spells out the second letter of the alphabet.

clue.text: Boasts few connections

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, a few
aunts are family connections, relatives

explanation.surface: Someone bragging that they have few contacts.
explanation.definitionFit: To vaunt is to brag or show off.

clue.text: Endless cash may be brought back in this pouch

indicators.note: brought back means the shortened word is read in reverse
endless means the last letter of cash is dropped

parts.note: the word is taken as written

explanation.surface: Money without limit might be returned in this bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' leaves CAS; 'brought back' turns it into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A sac is a bag-like cavity in a plant or animal.

clue.text: See a great deal in black-and-white when so guided

indicators.note: in places the large-amount word inside the colour word

parts.note: pied means patched in black and white, like a magpie
a lot is a great deal

explanation.surface: Watching a lot of monochrome television under someone's direction.
explanation.definitionFit: Piloted means steered or directed, as a ship is by its pilot.

clue.text: Value well-set-out AI papers

indicators.note: set out well means the letters are laid out anew

explanation.surface: Assess neatly presented first-rate documents.
explanation.walkthrough: The scan's 'Al' is really A1 or AI, meaning first-class.
explanation.definitionFit: To appraise is to assess the worth of something.

clue.text: Window fitting that's dear, having wood in it

indicators.note: in it means the wood sits inside the endearment

parts.note: pet is a term of endearment, a dear
elm is a timber tree

explanation.surface: Pricey curtain hardware made of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A pelmet is a narrow border fitted above a window to hide the curtain rail.

clue.text: Go off

parts.note: a Latin stage direction for several actors leaving the stage

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin stage direction means they leave, so actors depart.

clue.text: The last month an engineer would go round a port falling into decay

indicators.note: the month and engineer letters together surround the port name

parts.note: Dec is December, last month of the year
CE stands for civil engineer
Aden is a port in Yemen

explanation.surface: In December an engineer sails round a harbour that is crumbling.
explanation.definitionFit: Decadence is moral or cultural decline.

clue.text: Some humanitarian enterprises are touching

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A remark that some charitable ventures are moving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'are touching' means concerning, the old preposition.
explanation.definitionFit: Anent is an old word for about or concerning, as touching once meant.

clue.text: Originated from one single bloom

parts.note: a means one
a rose is a flower

explanation.surface: Something that began with one flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Arose means came into being or began.

clue.text: Allow in the head's painting equipment

indicators.note: in puts the permission word inside the head word

parts.note: the pate is the head
to let is to allow

explanation.surface: Imagining an artist's kit stowed in their mind.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist mixes colours on a palette, a flat board.

clue.text: Environment-friendly in the main?

parts.note: eco-friendly read as green, and the main is the sea, giving a colour

explanation.definitionFit: Sea-green is a bluish-green colour like ocean water, and the question mark flags the pun.

clue.text: Step out of order with little hesitation to give trouble

indicators.note: out of order means the letters of step are rearranged

parts.note: er is the sound of a brief hesitation

explanation.surface: Stepping out of line with barely a pause is bound to cause bother.
explanation.definitionFit: To pester is to annoy persistently.
